summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom the Fates killed with brazen clubs in the Gigantomachy — the Thoas named in Apollodorus 1.6.2, not the Lemnian or Aetolian kings of the same name.

story.text: Apollodorus names Thoas among the Giants destroyed when the Olympians fought with Heracles at their side: the Fates, fighting with brazen clubs, killed Agrius and Thoas. Thoas is one of the Giants named in that battle roll.
This Thoas is not the king of Lemnos and father of Hypsipyle, nor the Aetolian king, nor the suitor at Ithaca who bore the same name.
